title: US Imposes New Visa Restrictions on South Africa Over Racial Policies
detail: The Trump administration imposed new visa restrictions on South Africa, according to reporting by the New York Times. The move is linked to US concerns over South Africa's racial policies — including land reform legislation — and the country's foreign policy alignment, including its stance on Russia and China. The restrictions mark a significant escalation in diplomatic tensions between Washington and Pretoria under the GNU coalition government.
